about_the_game:
The prime minister has been kidnapped by the evil intergalactic war crimes tribunal! Your mission is simple: extract the prime minister.

Play the first 5 stages of this epically generic euro-schmup demo inspired by Blazing Lasers, Raptor Call of Shadows, and other classics.

Earn $pacecoin to upgrade your ship. Have access to 9 different upgrades. Fight over 20 different enemies.

Play for high score or for progression.

Shooting ships and picking up $pacecoin earns you points. You will get a bonus depending on how many hull points you have left. You will get a multiplier for each level you complete in sequence. Keeping the forcefield up also earns you points.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any modern distro with Vulkan/OpenGL support
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.5 GHz (x86_64 or ARM)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 620 or AMD Radeon Vega 3)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Distro with Vulkan drivers (e.g., Ubuntu 20.04+)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X / Intel Iris Xe)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
